title: 第17章 人知鬼恐怖鬼晓人心毒第18章 敢问仙人可得长生否
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
“好，那为师就收下了。”
霍道人微微一笑，却是没把顾铮的拜师礼放在心上，这位徒儿虽然有富贵之像，但现在也最多富贵一县，能送什么好礼物？
不过礼轻情意重，有这份心就够了，对他来说，这个徒儿才是最好的礼物。
他虽然无门无派，但也想把自己所学传承下去，只是之前收了三个资质不错记名弟子，却都没坚持下来，让他大失所望，此后熄了收徒的心思。
也就是看到顾铮诚意很足，因此没有直接拒绝，只是设定了一个很难达成的条件，却没有把门全部关上，留了一条微不可察的缝隙。
没想到自己这一心软，居然收了一个天赋顶好的徒弟。
霍道人打开木盒，不经意拔出长剑。
铿！
剑锋寒光一闪差点闪瞎了他的眼睛，定眼一看剑上细密的花纹，不由自主的轻喝一声：
“好剑！”
“给我瞧瞧！”
胡道人拿过长剑，扯下一根头发，贴在剑刃上任其落了下去。
头发无声无息的分成两段。
“吹毛断发，看这花纹，起码也是万锻之剑，铸剑材料虽然不是玄铁，某些方面却不比玄铁差。”
胡道人眼中闪烁着羡慕之色：
“顾铮，你从哪里得来的这口好剑？”
顾铮含糊其辞：“无意中得来的。”
从哪里得来的？
当然是买到的。
流水线打造，所谓的万锻之兵想买多少买多少。

这就是现代工业的强大。
霍道人倒吸一口凉气：“你确定铸剑的材料不比玄铁差？”
玄铁极为稀少，价格昂贵，有着一两玄铁十两金的说法，一方面是因为其稀少，另一方面是其很特殊，有着类似人的经脉般的纹路，可以无损传递法力，内息。
是绝佳的练兵材料。
用玄铁铸造兵器，一次锤炼就需要一份玄铁，千锻之兵需要一千份玄铁，万锻之兵需要一万份玄铁。
胡道人翻了翻白眼：“你还怀疑我的眼光？当然，我只是说材料的坚韧，硬度等等不逊于玄铁，我刚刚试了一下，传递法力方面这柄剑远远不如玄铁之兵，但即便如此，也是一把很好的防身利器了。”
“这把剑，在市面上，没有个一万两，别想买到，甚至于有价无市。”
“啧啧，你这徒弟可真好，一个拜师礼就这么厚重。”
胡道人羡慕不已，捶足顿胸，自己怎么就不坚持一下呢，这个徒弟要是自己的多好。
顾铮微微一笑：“师父喜欢就好。”
霍道人自然是满意不已：“你有心了。”
“师父，这柄剑算是神兵利器了吧。”顾铮试探性的问道。
铛！
霍道人轻弹剑锋，点点头：“在炼精化气境的修行者这一层面来看，这柄剑也称得上是神兵利器了，因为它够锋利，只可惜，法力传递阻塞很大，修为达到一定程度，比如进入炼气化神境这柄剑便至少能算是一柄普通的利器。”
说着，他沉声警示：“对我等修行者来说，除了自身之外，一切皆是外物，可用，却不可太过依赖，修为强大了，便是凡兵也能发挥出莫大的神威。”
顾铮郑重点头：“师父，我记住了！”
content_en:
"Okay, then I'll accept it as my teacher."
Taoist Huo smiled slightly, but he didn't take Gu Zheng's apprenticeship ceremony to heart. Although this disciple looked wealthy, he was only as rich as a county at most. What good gift could he give?
However, the etiquette is light but the affection is heavy. It is enough to have this heart. For him, this disciple is the best gift.
Although he had no family or sect, he also wanted to pass on what he had learned. However, he had accepted three registered disciples with good qualifications before, but none of them persisted. This made him greatly disappointed, and he gave up his intention to recruit disciples.
That is to say, he saw that Gu Zheng was sincere, so he did not refuse directly. He just set a condition that was difficult to achieve, but did not close the door completely, leaving an imperceptible gap.
Unexpectedly, he was so soft-hearted that he actually accepted a very talented disciple.
Huo Daoren opened the wooden box and inadvertently pulled out the long sword.
Keng!
The cold light from the sword edge almost blinded him. He took a closer look at the fine patterns on the sword and involuntarily shouted:
"What a sword!"
"Show me!"
Hu Daoren took the sword, pulled off a piece of hair, put it on the blade and let it fall.
The hair was silently divided into two sections.
"Blow the hair and cut off the hair. Look at the pattern. At least it is a sword made of ten thousand forgings. Although the material for making the sword is not black iron, it is no worse than black iron in some aspects."
Taoist Hu's eyes flashed with envy:
"Gu Zheng, where did you get this good sword?"
Gu Zheng was vague: "I got it by accident."
Where did you get it?
Of course I bought it.
They are built on an assembly line, so you can buy as many as you want from the so-called Ten Thousand Forged Soldiers.
This is the power of modern industry.
Huo Daoren took a breath: "Are you sure that the material used to make the sword is not worse than black iron?"
Black iron is extremely rare and expensive. There is a saying that one tael of dark iron is ten taels of gold. On the one hand, it is rare, and on the other hand, it is very special. It has lines similar to human meridians, which can transmit mana and inner breath without loss.
It is an excellent training material.
To forge weapons with dark iron, one tempering requires one part of dark iron, a thousand-forged weapon requires one thousand parts of dark iron, and a ten-thousand-forged weapon requires ten thousand parts of dark iron.
Hu Daoren rolled his eyes: "You still doubt my vision? Of course, I just said that the toughness, hardness, etc. of the material are not inferior to Black Iron. I just tried it. In terms of transmitting magic power, this sword is far inferior to the Black Iron Weapon, but even so, it is a very good self-defense weapon."
"You can't even buy this sword if you don't have ten thousand taels of it on the market, or even if it's expensive, it won't be available."
"Tsk, tsk, you are such a good apprentice. An apprenticeship ceremony is so profound."
Hu Daoren was filled with envy, beating his feet and chest, why didn't he insist on it? If only this apprentice could be his.
Gu Zheng smiled slightly: "Master, as long as you like it."
Huo Daoren was naturally very satisfied: "You are determined."
"Master, is this sword a magical weapon?" Gu Zheng asked tentatively.
clang!
Huo Daoren flicked the blade of the sword and nodded: "From the perspective of a practitioner in the Qi Refining and Transformation Realm, this sword can also be called a magical weapon because it is sharp enough. Unfortunately, the transmission of mana is greatly blocked. Once the cultivation level reaches a certain level, such as entering the Qi Refining and Divine Transformation Realm, this sword can at least be regarded as an ordinary sharp weapon."
As he spoke, he warned in a deep voice: "For practitioners like us, everything except ourselves is an external object. We can use it, but we should not rely too much on it. When our cultivation is strong, even ordinary soldiers can exert great power."
Gu Zheng nodded solemnly: "Master, I remember it!"
